text.en:
Section Two of Presidential Decree Numbered Eight hundred eighty-five, otherwise known as
the Revised Anti-Subversion is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. Subversive Associations and Organizations - Any association, organization, political party, or group
of persons organized for the purpose of overthrowing the Government of the Republic of the Philippines or for
the purpose of removing from the allegiance to said government or its laws, the territory of the Philippines or
any part thereof, with the open or covert assistance or support of a foreign power, by force, violence, deceit or
other illegal means shall be considered and is hereby declared a subversive organization."
